dated: Ley Núm. 1/2024 (Ley Tributaria), in force for 2025

entries.name: Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales (inmuebles)
entries.statute: Ley 1/2024 art. 233 2) a) (5 % between residents; 10 % with non-residents)
entries.doc: art. 233: "Para la liquidación del Impuesto sobre Transmisiones Patrimoniales, se aplicará los tipos de gravámenes siguientes: 1) En la transmisión a título oneroso de fondos de comercio o derechos de arrendamiento: 2% 2) En la transmisión a título oneroso de bienes muebles, inmuebles y derechos reales, el tipo de gravamen será: a) Entre residentes: 5% b) Entre residentes y no residentes y entre no residentes: 10%".
notes: Ley 1/2024 art. 233: 5 % between residents applied; 10 % when a party is non-resident (purchase nonResident flag not mapped)

entries.name: Impuesto sobre Bienes Inmuebles, urban property (0,05 % of 30 % of land and building value)
entries.doc: art. 213 1): for urban property the taxable base is 30 % of the sum of the values of land and building (30 % of the price of a transfer in the previous year); art. 214 1): rate 0,05 % of that base, i.e. 0,015 % of the value, applied in one step (15 / 100 000). The household's holdings are taken as urban property in Malabo or Bata (no regional rebate).
unsupported: rebates of 40 % / 60 % / 100 % outside Malabo and Bata (art. 211)

entries.name: Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio
entries.statute: Ley 1/2024 art. 179 (charge), mínimo exento 300 000 000 F (base liquidable), baremo of the cuota (0,015 % … 0,090 %)
entries.doc: art. 179: "El Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio, es un tributo de carácter directo y de naturaleza personal"; base liquidable: "deduciendo del patrimonio neto el mínimo exento equivalente a Trescientos Millones (300.000.000) de F.CFA"; "la cuota tributaria del Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio, se determinará conforme el baremo siguiente: 300.000.001-500.000.000 0,015% 30.000; 500.000.001-700.000.000 0,030% 90.000; 700.000.001-900.000.000 0,045% 180.000; 900.000.001-1.100.000.000 0,060% 300.000; 1.100.000.001-1.500.000.000 0,075% 600.000; Más de 1.500.000.000 0,090%". The cumulative column (30 000 = 0,015 % of 200 000 000; 90 000 = 30 000 + 0,030 % of 200 000 000; …) shows a marginal scale on net wealth above 300 000 000. Devengo 31 December (art. 202).
notes: Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio: net wealth = statutory value less debt of the household's assets; the valuation rules (shares, art. 190 ff.) and exemptions not applied

entries.name: Stamp duty (IAJD) on conveyances of property: no tariff for notarial deeds
entries.statute: Ley n.º 1/2024 Tributaria (19 November 2024, in force on publication; OCR world/B08-central-africa-fr/gq/law/rescue3/Ley1-2024_ocr_spa.txt) art. 240-247 Impuesto sobre Actos Jurídicos Documentados
entries.why: art. 241 7) lists 'las escrituras, actas y testimonios notariales' as taxable operations and art. 243 1) e) gives the base of first copies of notarial deeds, but the tariff of art. 245 has only three items: preventive annotations in notarial and property / commercial registers 0,15 %, bills of exchange and similar titles 0,5 %, BVMAC listing authorisations 1 %. No rate applies to the deed of a home purchase, so a household's conveyance bears no IAJD; the transfer itself is taxed by the ITP (P5, art. 233). A preventive annotation (0,15 %) is not part of an ordinary purchase and is not modelled

entries.name: INSESO employer contribution (21,5 % of wages, all branches, no ceiling)
entries.statute: US SSA, Social Security Programs Throughout the World (SSPTW), Africa 2019, Equatorial Guinea (Wayback 2020-08-02, R4/fetch/p14/ssptw_equatorial-guinea.txt; facts restated): employer 21,5 % of gross covered monthly pay, with no earnings ceiling; the contribution also finances sickness, maternity, work injury and family allowances; official secondary, edition 2019 (flagged)
entries.doc: One employer rate for all branches. Fourteenth pass (FT reviewer 4: family not modelled).
